courses.title: Readings in World History to 1500
courses.description: In-depth study and analysis of common themes, issues, and documents in world civilizations to 1500 CE.

courses.title: Reading in World History from 1500
courses.description: In-depth study and analysis of common themes, issues, and documents in world civilizations from 1500 to the present.

courses.title: Advanced Digital Research Project in World History
courses.description: Advanced research project in the world history using digital resources for research and presentation, under faculty supervision.

courses.title: Advanced Digital Research Project in United States History
courses.description: Advanced research project in United States history using digital resources for research and presentation, under faculty supervision.

courses.title: Readings in Early U.S. History
courses.description: In-depth graduate study and analysis of major themes, problems, and trends in U.S. history from Colonial times to the Civil War.

courses.title: Readings in Modern U.S. History
courses.description: In-depth graduate study and analysis of major subjects, themes, problems, and trends in U.S. history from 1877 to present.

courses.title: Advanced Graduate Methods
courses.description: Advanced historical research methods, including research in electronic databases and digital archives. Current historiographical approaches. Choosing a topic and the process of research, writing, annotating, and presenting the research.

courses.title: Advanced Digital Research Project in History Methods
courses.description: Advanced research project in the methods and theories of history using digital resources for research and presentation, under faculty supervision.

courses.title: Readings in California History
courses.description: Seminar in California history. Graduate level readings and analysis of major episodes and epochs of California history.

courses.title: Contemporary Historiography
courses.description: Close reading and analysis of recent trends in historiography, including social history, feminist and gender theory, cultural studies, post-colonial studies, post-structuralism, memory studies, transnational and entangled histories.

courses.title: Digital Research Project in Historiography
courses.description: Advanced research project in historiography using digital resources for research and/or presentation, under faculty supervision.

courses.title: Comprehensive Exam Preparation
courses.description: Preparation for comprehensive exams. May be taken up to two times for a total credit of 2 units.

courses.title: Master’s Thesis
courses.description: Research and writing the MA thesis under faculty supervision. Directed research.

courses.title: Cal Poly Pomona Graduate Sponsored Summer Experience
courses.description: Enrollment in this 0-unit course allows students to receive university services while participating in a Cal Poly Pomona sponsored summer experience.
